name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum: a 65 mm tube with a 35 mm push-in plug and a straight air channel. The plug matches the nozzle opening: one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle (measured), 41.8 mm wide (opening 42 mm). 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs (0.4 mm) on each long side so it grips by friction; 45 degree lead-in; the wider tube stops against the nozzle. Prints standing on its wide end, no supports (PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters). Print the short fit test first. Not printed or fitted.
